name: The Modern Technologist
oneLiner: Ken's face is the fixed centre of a precise instrument: everything he has made orbits him at the angle of its theme and the distance of its age, so the newest work sits closest to him and the site re-draws itself every time he publishes.
type: Mona Sans (variable width 75–125 and weight, display and text) · JetBrains Mono (data, labels, the automated Digest) · Instrument Serif Italic (Ken's own voice: quotes and director's note). All self-hosted woff2, 84 KB total.
signature: The Orbit: Ken's portrait at the centre of a radial instrument where every build, essay, video and short is placed by theme (angle) and age (distance), documented links are drawn as threads that light up on hover, and a month scrubber rewinds the whole body of work so you can watch it grow outward from him.
